title: Idea-Space Collapse: Measuring Homogeneity in AI-Generated Research Brainstorms

original_idea.body:
# Idea-Space Collapse: Measuring Homogeneity in AI-Generated Research Brainstorms

**Problem:** Success state: scientists relying on AI for ideation know whether different models broaden their option space or funnel them to the same ideas.

**Direction:** Pose 'brainstorm N approaches' prompts to several open models. Embed and cluster all ideas; measure how much the union of cross-model ideas exceeds any single model.

**Why it matters:** If AI ideation collapses onto the same ideas, the collective epistemic search of human-AI teams narrows.

**Relevant context:** Directly extends Artificial Hivemind's brainstorm/ideation category (Infinity-Chat).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Vague-to-plausible: homogenization-of-thought is real but the link to a concrete catastrophic AI risk is broad/diffuse.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt models, embed and cluster ideas; standard tools, beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped measurement of idea overlap/marginal diversity with clear metrics.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Long-horizon epistemic-diversity question labs deprioritize; public models.

novelty.reasoning: Diversity of LLM generations is studied; cross-model ideation-collapse measurement may be open.
